description: This PHP class 'Dependent' is part of a report display system within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management project. It models a dependent entity related to an employee, providing methods to convert the data into an array based on specified fields and mapping class methods to data fields.

classes.name: Dependent
classes.description: A data transfer object representing an employee's dependent within a reporting context, capable of normalizing dependent data for display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Dependent object with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the dependent data into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping from field names to class method chains for data retrieval.
